entries.name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the elbow fixed at (51.55, 16.8) - the raised upper arm holds 12.5 exactly - while the forearm folds from a 50-degree stretch (the hands behind the head, on the back of the head so the face stays clear) to 173 degrees at the extension. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a cable rope overhead triceps extens

frames.caption: Hold the rope overhead with the elbows aiming through one steady line.
Let the hands travel behind the head under control.
Feel the stretch at the bottom of the range.
Extend through the forearms only.
Finish with the arms long and the elbows quiet.

entries.name: Cable One Arm Tricep Extension
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the same overhead chain on the working arm while the far arm hangs at the hip (the unilateral tell an athlete sees at a glance), the handle on a cable to the drawn high pulley. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a one-arm cable overhead triceps ext

frames.caption: Hold the cable handle overhead with the free hand at the hip.
Lower the handle behind the head without the elbow drifting.
Pause in the stretch with the upper arm still.
Extend through the forearm on the working side.
Finish long, then control the return.

entries.name: Dumbbell Tricep Extension -Pronated Grip
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the same overhead chain with the dumbbell drawn END-ON at the hands (Entry 0181 - the pronated grip reads as the plate face), which is the visual difference from the neutral-grip version beside it. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a pronated-grip dumbbell overhead tr

frames.caption: Hold the dumbbell overhead with the palm turned down.
Lower behind the head through the stretch.
Keep the elbow line steady at the bottom.
Extend through the forearms with the grip unchanged.
Finish with the bell stacked over the shoulder.

entries.name: Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the same overhead chain with the dumbbell drawn across at the hands (the bell lies along the forearm), which is the visual difference from the end-on pronated version beside it. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a standing dumbbell overhead triceps

frames.caption: Hold the dumbbell overhead with the elbows tucked.
Lower into the stretch under control.
Pause where the triceps lengthens.
Press the bell back overhead through the forearms.
Finish tall with the bell steady overhead.

entries.name: Standing Overhead Barbell Triceps Extension
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the same overhead chain with the barbell drawn END-ON at the hands (Entry 0181 - the plate pairs ride the wrists), the family tell against the dumbbell versions. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a standing overhead barbell triceps

frames.caption: Hold the barbell overhead with the elbows narrow.
Lower the bar behind the head slowly.
Keep the bar path the same every rep.
Extend through the forearms without moving the elbows.
Finish with the bar locked over the shoulders.
